steps.message: Delete all my notes in Markor.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i markor; echo '---'; ls -la /storage/emulated/0 | grep -i markor; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard | grep -i markor"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i markor; echo '---'; ls -la /storage/emulated/0 | grep -i markor; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard | grep -i markor""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "ls -la /sdcard/Documents 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard/Download 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard/Notes 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; find /sdcard/Documents -maxdepth 3 \( -iname '*markor*' -o -iname '*.md' -o -iname '*.txt' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 200"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "ls -la /sdcard/Documents 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard/Download 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard/Notes 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; find /sdcard/Documents -maxdepth 3 \( -iname '*markor*' -o -iname '*.md' -o -iname '*.txt' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 200""
